designDetails.silhouette: Inherit the Boiler identity: gaunt damaged biped with a drooping elongated ridged head, short deformed dorsal tubes, narrow hunched torso, exactly two long bent skeletal arms, two bowed digitigrade legs, a complete tail and clustered shoulder/back/rib/hip boils. It must never collapse into the low quadruped Burster silhouette.
designDetails.palette: Warm parchment-ivory, pearl gray and pale beige exoskeleton; cool taupe-gray recesses, restrained rose-beige membranes, dark mouth cavity and pale yellow-green to weak acid-amber translucent cysts that remain functionally legible.
designDetails.surface: Keep damaged cranial ridges, ribbed torso, tendon channels, cyst clusters, deformed dorsal tubes and tail segmentation readable through value and material contrast. The albino surface is newly authored, never a white filter over base frames.
designDetails.anatomy: One blind damaged elongated head, one hunched ribbed torso, exactly two clawed arms, two bowed digitigrade legs, one continuous tail and multiple attached cystic boils. No eyes, equipment, armor or clothing.
designDetails.orientation: Strict orthographic gameplay profile facing RIGHT in all 32 poses; damaged head, arms, feet, cyst silhouette and full tail remain wholly inside each cell without camera rotation.
designDetails.scale: Use the reviewed base silhouette proportions only. The base metadata records a single final pack scale, but its sourceScaleByClip calibration and physical-anchor review are not certified; future Albino Boiler generation must establish and review its own all-profile scale.
designDetails.root: Use a pelvis/proximal-leg root projected to the supporting-foot floor. Hunch depth, cyst inflation, tail arc and collapse never redefine root x or ground contact.
designDetails.attackContinuity: Eight chronological poses show anticipation, progressive torso/cyst inflation, unstable extension, terminal detonation preparation and a readable final damage trigger. Do not jump directly between neutral and maximum bloat, and do not reuse death poses as attack recovery.
designDetails.background: True transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no shadow, scenery, hive resin, text, explosion cloud or grid.
